description: 해양수산부_해양침적폐기물 실시설계 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 해양수산부. 실시설계를 통해 해양침적폐기물의 정화 작업이 필요한 항만, 해역 등을 선별하고 정화 사업을 수행하게 됩니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 해양수산부. Its tags are 해양침적폐기물, 실시설계, 조사사업, 해양생태계보전, 해양환경개선. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-06-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
